sam: Quick heads-up — proposal to deprecate messages[].metadata (v1) in chat/completions response. Planning to move that info into response.top_level_metadata to make typed tooling (SDKs, linters) easier. RFC: https://go/rfc-msg-meta

maya: timeline?

sam: Proposed timeline:
- server-side shim that copies metadata -> top_level_metadata for 6 months with a warning header
- SDKs and linters emit warnings when code reads messages[].metadata
- remove shim after 6 months
Need ack from eng-runtime + devex before I open PRs.

alex: Server shim sounds reasonable. Questions:
1) Will streaming include the new field in deltas? We need to avoid breaking stream parsers.
2) Any perf impact on small responses?

sam: Good q's. Plan: during shim period stream will include BOTH fields to keep parsers happy. For deltas we'll emit the top-level metadata as a final delta event so incremental parsers that only look for choices[0].delta won't miss it. Example shapes:

```
OLD:
{
  "id": "...",
  "choices": [
    { "message": { "content": "...", "metadata": { "detected_intent": "x" } } }
  ]
}

NEW (during shim):
{
  "id": "...",
  "top_level_metadata": { "detected_intent": "x" },
  "choices": [
    { "message": { "content": "..." } }
  ]
}
```

jen: Docs — I can author migration guide + code snippets for JS/Python. Also propose adding header `X-Redwood-Meta-Warn: metadata-deprecated` while shim is active.

runtime-bot: rolling plan: feature-flag `meta_shim` will land in staging tomorrow, can flip to canary after tests.

alex: I'll add a runtime unit test to assert both shapes parse and an e2e that validates final delta contains `top_level_metadata`.

sam: I'll open the RFC PR and a small server shim PR. Private deployments: default OFF; customers can enable with `compat.enable_metadata_shim=true` in their private config. Dedicated/hosted: default ON.

sam: pinging @eng-runtime @devex for final ack. Thanks :thumbsup:
